name: The Hunt Continues
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A tauren skilled in the ways of the hunt knows that his prey is not for mere trophy. The beasts of the plains provide us with a means of survival. You will make quite an impression on the elders if you can bring back some highly valued Mountain Cougar Pelts. You can find the beasts lurking in the hills to the south.

Our children need clothing and our tents need mending.
narrative.objectives: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts.
narrative.offerRewardText: The Tauren of Narache thank you for these provisions, adventurer. With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
narrative.requestItemsText: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 2 to 4, 870 XP in all.

quests.name: The Hunt Begins
quests.objectiveText: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat.

quests.name: The Hunt Continues
quests.objectiveText: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts.

quests.name: The Battleboars
quests.objectiveText: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to kill Battleboars and bring back 8 Battleboar Snouts and 8 Battleboar Flanks.
